qad_parent_reuse: Reuse original log/p1 QAD state only after validating its immutable source/input/artifact provenance and default-behavior compatibility. Other parents share unchanged calibration fitting inputs but use fresh correctly fingerprinted layer-wise states.

training_constants.other_training_configuration: Copy exact original run configuration, calibration/train/validation IDs, seed, dtype, batch, warmup, norms, latent units and allocation settings; only declared factors change.

training_efficiency.quality_matrix_uses_cache: Enable only after output, gradient, optimizer-update and export parity for both scale units and fixed/trainable tables. Otherwise retain uncached reference; no silent numerical relaxation.
training_efficiency.timing: Separate matched on/off measurement; raw training runs with KFD stalls are not valid speed comparisons.

runtime_screen.quality_models: All 24 quality configurations, including the preserved control
runtime_screen.warmup: Excluded same-shape warmup and confirmed prefix-cache reset before every timed cell.
runtime_screen.quality_gate: Independent native-kernel references and graph replay first; per-profile native correctness and NLL parity versus the same quantized weights. Screening is not final ABBA qualification.

qualification.quality_selection: Freeze validation ranking before scoring benchmark holdouts. Report all 24 on the original 28 mix and seven docs windows, with full-vocabulary HF KL, NLL/PPL, paired-window intervals and raw token/hash checks. Confirm the top two validation-selected models on an independently frozen fresh holdout.
qualification.performance_finalists: Fresh matched ABBA qualification for validation-selected quality finalists and measured runtime Pareto finalists, keeping ladder DEFAULT and CPTC DEFAULT controls. Verify combined settings rather than adding isolated gains.
metrics: KV token capacity at fixed pool
loaded-model memory and whole-device VRAM snapshots
training implementation timing under valid guards
limits: Best tested finite matrix, not proof of universal optimum.
H16 adaptation, not full-paper RHT reproduction.
Fixed KV pool does not automatically convert smaller checkpoint bytes into capacity gain.
MTP streaming chunk ITL is not individual-token ITL.

execution_admission: Pin committed implementation and exact built library before GPU execution.
Verify all current guards, lease, STOP fingerprint, topology, power, fans and quiet/boot protocols.
Validate persisted parent/head-input/calibration provenance; never bypass a cache mismatch by rewriting its fingerprint.
Every trial has a fresh output/receipt directory; no overwrites of original controls.
Freeze fresh confirmatory holdout before the first new optimization run.
